fixed: Free-text entry now reads every move's own name typed on its own, such as `hey`, `mad robin`, `contra corners` or `give & take`, and your dialect's own move names, instead of keeping them as custom figures. It also reads `hey for four`, `half hey`, `full hey`, `turn as a couple`, turn amounts in words such as `allemande right once and a half` (which used to come out as once), older role words such as `ravens` by what they mean, and a count that says `beats`, such as `neighbor swing (16 beats)`.

changed: `parseFreeTextFigureEntry` adds a typed-by-a-caller layer (`typed_figure_names.dart`): spoken turn amounts are rewritten before the parse, the built-in discouraged role terms are retried by their meaning, and a line no parse reads is looked up whole as a taxonomy, alias, caller-phrasing or dialect move name. A count may carry a `beats` unit. Imports are unchanged; the custom-figure re-parse reads counts as before, except that a saved custom left with a second, `beats`-unit count once its count is peeled stays custom instead of upgrading with both counts.
